tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Italian world and international days by title, official title, description or topic. Returns citable records and explicit verification status. Use fetch for details.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the published editorial text, dates, primary sources and correction history of an exact day identifier returned by search or list_days.

tools.name: list_days
tools.description: List days on a date or in an inclusive date range (maximum 366 days). Defaults to today in Europe/Rome. Resolves movable annual dates and excludes expired recurrences.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; omit both dates for today.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List public topic names, slugs and record counts. Use a slug as the topic filter in search or list_days.
